entities.summary: Janne Parviainen is a Finnish heavy metal drummer who plays in the bands Sinergy, Barathrum and Ensiferum. He is a former member of Waltari and Zwanziger. Janne Parviainen was a composers & musicians from Finland (b. 1973, Finland). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
